metadata.mode_label: MOCK MODE: metrics measure the deterministic rule-based extractor (rules-extractor-1.0), not an LLM. They say nothing about LLM extraction quality.

definitions.overall_field_accuracy: matching (document, field) pairs / all pairs applicable to the expected document type
definitions.field_weighted_score: weighted matches / total weight; critical fields weight 2.0, others 1.0
definitions.critical_field_error_rate: mismatched critical (document, field) pairs / critical pairs
definitions.missing_field_detection_rate: pairs where label is null and extractor returned null / pairs where label is null
definitions.unsupported_value_rate: pairs where label is null but extractor returned a value / pairs where label is null
definitions.present_field_recall: pairs where label has a value and extractor returned any value / pairs where label has a value
definitions.money_exact_match_rate: money pairs equal to the cent / money pairs with a labeled value
definitions.money_mean_abs_error: mean |expected - actual| over money pairs where both are non-null

classification.definition: Per-class precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN) over documents; macro F1 averages classes with support > 0.

definitions.recurring_income_agreement: cases whose recurring annual income equals the label to the cent (both null counts as agreement) / all cases
definitions.income_pattern_agreement: cases whose RECURRING/VARIABLE/UNKNOWN pattern equals the label / all cases

definitions.outcome_agreement: cases whose final outcome equals the label / all cases
definitions.rule_level_agreement: (case, rule) pairs where FAIL vs not-FAIL equals the label / cases x rules
definitions.false_approval_rate: cases output APPROVE whose label is not APPROVE / cases whose label is not APPROVE
definitions.incorrect_escalation_rate: cases output REFER_FOR_REVIEW whose label is not REFER / cases whose label is not REFER
definitions.missing_evidence_detection_rate: cases labeled with a failing evidence rule (R001_REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS, R002_CRITICAL_FIELDS_PRESENT, R012_DOCUMENT_RECENCY) where at least one such rule failed / those cases

definitions.outcome_agreement: cases whose final outcome equals the label / all cases
definitions.rule_level_agreement: (case, rule) pairs where FAIL vs not-FAIL equals the label / cases x rules
definitions.false_approval_rate: cases output APPROVE whose label is not APPROVE / cases whose label is not APPROVE
definitions.incorrect_escalation_rate: cases output REFER_FOR_REVIEW whose label is not REFER / cases whose label is not REFER
definitions.missing_evidence_detection_rate: cases labeled with a failing evidence rule (R001_REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS, R002_CRITICAL_FIELDS_PRESENT, R012_DOCUMENT_RECENCY) where at least one such rule failed / those cases

cases.description: Biweekly pay stub and matching employment letter
cases.reason: Complete evidence; 3,076.92 x 26 = 79,999.92 is within 5% of the documented 80,000 salary and above the 50,000 threshold.

cases.description: Semi-monthly pay statement (tabular layout) and letter
cases.reason: 4,166.67 x 24 = 100,000.08 matches the 100,000 salary; all evidence present and consistent.

cases.description: Weekly pay stub and letter
cases.reason: 1,250.00 x 52 = 65,000.00 equals the documented salary.

cases.description: Monthly pay statement and letter
cases.reason: 7,500.00 x 12 = 90,000.00 equals the documented salary.

cases.description: Pay stub, letter and corroborating bank statement
cases.reason: Income 70,000.06 matches salary; two payroll deposits equal the stub net pay.

cases.description: Two consecutive biweekly stubs and letter, all PDF
cases.reason: Two stubs with identical gross (0% variation); 3,461.54 x 26 = 90,000.04 matches salary.

cases.description: PDF pay stub and PDF letter
cases.reason: 2,916.67 x 24 = 70,000.08 matches the documented salary.

cases.description: Salary differs from annualized pay but within tolerance
cases.reason: 79,999.92 vs 82,000 is a 2.44% variance, inside the 5% tolerance.

cases.description: Employer written with and without legal suffix
cases.reason: 'Aurora Dental Group Inc.' and 'Aurora Dental Group' are the same employer after suffix normalization; 60,000 matches.

cases.description: Bank statement includes non-payroll credits
cases.reason: E-transfer and interest are not payroll and must be excluded; payroll deposits corroborate net pay.

cases.description: Pay stub only; no employment letter
cases.reason: Employment letter is a required document type.

cases.description: Employment letter only; no pay stub
cases.reason: No pay stub, so recurring income cannot be established.

cases.description: Pay stub omits gross pay
cases.reason: Gross pay is critical and absent; the system must not back-calculate it from net or YTD.

cases.description: Pay stub omits the pay period
cases.reason: Pay period start and end are critical fields.

cases.description: Letter does not state a salary (optional field)
cases.reason: Base salary is optional; with no salary the comparison rule is not applicable and pay stub income suffices.

cases.description: Most recent pay stub is stale
cases.reason: Pay date 2026-05-29 is 139 days before the as-of date (limit 60).

cases.description: Pay stub does not state pay frequency
cases.reason: Frequency must be stated, not inferred from period length; without it income is not annualized.

cases.description: Bank statement only
cases.reason: Deposits alone are not income evidence under the demo policy.

cases.description: Letter salary far above pay stub income
Different employers on stub and letter
cases.reason: Employer names differ after normalization.

cases.description: Different employee names on stub and letter
cases.reason: Documents name different people.

cases.description: Two letters with different salaries
cases.reason: Two letters state 70,000 and 85,000; conflicting evidence needs review.

cases.description: Bank deposits do not match net pay
cases.reason: Payroll deposits of 1,200.00 do not match net pay 2,412.66.

cases.description: Pay period ends before it starts
cases.reason: Reversed pay period dates.

cases.description: Pay date in the future
cases.reason: Pay period and pay date are after the 2026-10-15 as-of date.

cases.description: Weekly frequency with a 30-day pay period
cases.reason: A 30-day period is inconsistent with weekly pay.

cases.description: Employment start date in the future
cases.reason: Start date 2027-01-10 is after the as-of date while a current pay stub exists.

cases.description: Year-to-date gross lower than current gross
cases.reason: YTD 1,250.00 cannot be below the current period gross 2,500.00.

cases.description: Net pay exceeds gross pay
cases.reason: Net 3,150.00 above gross 2,800.00 is implausible.

cases.description: Same pay stub file uploaded twice
cases.reason: Byte-identical pay stub submitted twice.

cases.description: Same pay stub as TXT and PDF
cases.reason: Different files with the same pay stub facts (employer, period, pay date, gross).

cases.description: Commission income varies between stubs
cases.reason: Gross varies 48.65% between stubs; variable income must not be annualized as recurring.

cases.description: Contractor paid per assignment
cases.reason: Irregular frequency; income cannot be annualized.

cases.description: Part-time weekly hours vary
cases.reason: Weekly gross ranges 980-1,240 (23.46% variation).

cases.description: Garbled text file alongside a valid letter
cases.reason: Garbled document cannot be classified; refer so a person can inspect it (missing pay stub also noted).

cases.description: Corrupted PDF alongside a valid letter
cases.reason: PDF cannot be parsed.

cases.description: Scanned PDF with no text layer
cases.reason: No text layer; OCR is out of scope, so the document is unreadable.

cases.description: Whitespace-only text file
cases.reason: Empty content is unreadable and no evidence is present.

cases.description: Letter gives approximate total compensation, not base salary
cases.reason: Approximate total compensation is not an explicit base salary, so base_annual_salary must be null; stub income 78,000 passes.

cases.description: Pay date written as ambiguous numeric date
cases.reason: 09/10/2026 could be September 10 or October 9; the value must be null rather than guessed.

cases.description: Promotional amounts on stub and salary band in letter
cases.reason: Irrelevant amounts must be ignored; 3,750.00 x 24 = 90,000.00 matches the salary.

cases.description: Letter mentions an outdated starting salary
cases.reason: Only the current base salary (78,000) counts; 3,250 x 24 = 78,000.

cases.description: Bank statement with large non-payroll credits
cases.reason: Savings transfer and tax refund are not income; payroll deposits corroborate.

cases.description: Pay stub contains instructions to the AI
cases.reason: Gross must remain 1,923.08; the manipulation attempt itself requires review.

cases.description: Letter contains a fake assistant turn inflating salary
cases.reason: Salary must remain 52,000; injected text requires review.

cases.description: Injected instruction hidden in a bank transaction description
cases.reason: Instruction-like text in a transaction description is a manipulation signal; the 0.01 credit is not payroll.

cases.description: Clean documents but income below threshold
cases.reason: 800 x 52 = 41,600 is below the 50,000 demo threshold.

cases.description: Letter states employment has ended
cases.reason: Employment is no longer active.

cases.description: Documents in an unsupported currency
cases.reason: USD is not an allowed currency under the demo policy.

cases.description: Pay advice written as an email
cases.reason: All pay facts are stated in prose; 2,750 x 26 = 71,500 matches. Tests extraction beyond fixed templates.
